_variant_note: Axis-7 wrong AMOUNT on a dispute (the siblings covered the phantom transaction and the wrong reference digits). The customer disputes 'a Rs 2,499 ShopFast debit on 12 Aug' — the merchant and date match a real record, but the actual amount is Rs 2,549. The correction must reach the write's ARGS: related_transaction_id must be the real record's reference (UTR-88122001) and the description must carry the corrected Rs 2,549 figure — a prose-only 'your amount looks wrong' with no corrected write is the demoted pattern. The careless failure: raising the dispute with the customer's wrong amount or with no related_transaction_id.

arguments.description: Customer disputes an unauthorized Rs 2,549 debit (UTR-88122001, SHOPFAST ONLINE, 2026-08-12) they did not make.

raise_request._comment: THE GATE: the dispute must carry the real record's reference and the correction must reach the write — related_transaction_id pinned; the description should state the corrected Rs 2,549 (judge-gated, description is free text).

gold.expected_resolution: The customer disputes a 'Rs 2,499 ShopFast debit on 12 Aug'. The transaction history shows the ShopFast debit on 12 Aug is actually Rs 2,549 (reference UTR-88122001) — the customer misremembered the amount. The assistant must locate the real transaction, surface the correction, and after confirmation raise the dispute with the REAL reference (UTR-88122001) and the corrected Rs 2,549 figure in the description. Raising the dispute with the wrong amount (or without the related_transaction_id), or correcting in prose but writing the wrong details, is the failure.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant locates the real ShopFast debit (Rs 2,549, UTR-88122001) via get_transaction_history, corrects the customer's Rs 2,499 belief, and after confirmation raises the dispute with the real reference and the corrected amount. Raising with the wrong amount or wrong/missing reference fails.
